SwitchPreference.android:title: Enable Securize
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Disabling may fix play services on uncertified devices

SwitchPreference.android:title: Treat virtual sensors as real
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Treat all virtual fingerprint sensors as real\nWarning: This can cause bootloops - use with extreme care\nRequires a reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Activity Anim Perf Override
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Forces the use of performance optimization in activity animations\nRequires reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: LMK Tweaks
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Apply tweaks to Low Memory Killer to improve stability and prevent aggressive shutdowns\nRequires reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Bluetooth fix
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Maybe this will fix your Bluetooth problem.\nRequires reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Unisoc black screen workaround
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Enables a workaround for black screen issues on some Unisoc devices. May affect color-based display features. Requires framework support. Applies instantly

SwitchPreference.android:title: Scroll Boost
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Improves scrolling smoothness by applying a temporary performance boost during scroll gestures. On heavier apps, it may use a more aggressive performance profile depending on vendor support. On low-RAM devices, this may increase memory pressure and reduce smoothness in some situations.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Universal legacy-kernel BPF fallback
SwitchPreference.android:summary: ON (true): uses the real kernel version and enables the safer traffic-statistics fallback. Recommended for older kernels and may keep the traffic indicator working. OFF (false): reports kernel 5.10.239 to enable the full BPF compatibility path and may fix firewall-bypass connectivity. Disabling the fallback can break the traffic indicator or cause a black screen, OEM screen, Wi-Fi boot failure, or bootloader issue on unsupported devices. Reboot required. This patch is universal for supported SoC vendors. The MTK BPF Patcher is optional and only applies to supported MediaTek kernels.

SwitchPreference.android:title: A2dp Identity address
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Some devices connect over Bluetooth correctly, but fail to expose the A2DP output route to AudioPolicyManager, causing media audio to continue playing through the phone speaker.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Safe Media Volume Bypas
SwitchPreference.android:summary: disable framework safe media volume checks, warnings, and volume clamping.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Prefer hardware codecs
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Use vendor hardware codecs instead of software codecs for video recording\nOnly enable if video recording already works on your device\nRequires reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Force software codecs
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Use software/OMX codecs instead of vendor hardware codecs for video recording\nEnable only if video recording fails or hangs on your device\nRequires reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Fix screen recorder
SwitchPreference.android:summary:
Enable compatibility mode for screen recording
Prioritizes software codecs for input surface
Enable if screen recorder shows black screen or crashes
Requires reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Max compatibility mode
SwitchPreference.android:summary:
Maximum codec compatibility for old and new devices
Software codecs prioritized, C2 enabled
Enable if screen recorder or video recording fails
Requires reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Legacy mode (Android 9 or less)
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Disable Codec2 completely, use only OMX codecs\nEnable for Android 9 or older devices, or when C2 causes bootloop/crash\nRequires reboot
